business_problem: As Levi Strauss & Co. scales its direct-to-consumer business, employees navigated fragmented systems and complex workflows, making it difficult to access insights and operate at the speed modern retail demands.
solution_summary: Levi Strauss & Co. used Microsoft Foundry and GitHub Copilot to build purpose-driven agents plus a unified Super Agent that simplifies how employees work across its direct-to-consumer business. The retailer wanted to remove friction created by fragmented systems and multi-step workflows that slowed access to information and decision-making. Microsoft Foundry became the orchestration layer for agents that connect data sources and workflows, while GitHub Copilot supported development work and Microsoft Teams provided a familiar collaboration surface. The result is an AI-enabled workplace model that gives employees faster access to insights and helps the company operate at the pace required by modern retail.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Foundry
solution_components.role: Coordinates the agents and shared tooling behind the unified super-agent experience.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.

solution_components.name: GitHub Copilot
solution_components.role: Assists developers with code generation and implementation tasks.

business_outcome: By orchestrating purpose-built agents through a unified Super Agent, Levi Strauss & Co. reduced complexity, accelerated decision-making, and enabled real-time access to insights across the business.

Levi Strauss & Co. uses Microsoft Foundry and GitHub Copilot to build purpose-driven agents and a unified Super Agent that orchestrates workflows, connects data, and simplifies how work gets done.
